channel.title: Austropical blog
channel.description: Short posts on açaí, tropical fruit sorbet, açaí bowls and the road to US freezers in March 2027.

item.title: What does açaí taste like?
item.description: Açaí is deep and earthy, like dark berries with a hint of dark chocolate, and barely sweet on its own. What to expect, and how our four açaí sorbets differ.

item.title: How to set up an açaí bowl bar for a party
item.description: An açaí bowl bar is the easiest dessert table to run: a few pints of sorbet, four toppings and a scoop. What you need, how much, and how to keep it cold.

item.title: How to make a pitaya bowl without a blender
item.description: A pitaya bowl is a dragon fruit bowl: hot pink, bright and fruity. Scoop 2/3 cup of Dragon Fruit & Pineapple sorbet, add your toppings and eat. No blender.

item.title: Açaí bowl toppings: what to put on top, and how
item.description: The four açaí bowl toppings we use (granola, banana, strawberry and coconut), how to lay them out, and ten bowls to try. Build any of them in the bowl builder.

item.title: What is açaí sorbet, and how is it different from an açaí bowl base?
item.description: Açaí sorbet is a ready-to-scoop frozen dessert made from açaí, water and sugar. How it differs from a blended açaí bowl base, and exactly what goes into ours.

item.title: Pink guava and acerola: two Brazilian fruits in one sorbet
item.description: Pink guava and acerola are two Brazilian fruits. What they are, and what goes into our rosy Pink Guava & Acerola sorbet.

item.title: Organic mango sorbet: what USDA Organic means on our pack
item.description: Organic Mango sorbet is mostly mango, and USDA certified organic. What the seal means, who certified it, and which three Austropical flavors carry it.

item.title: How to make an açaí bowl at home without a blender
item.description: Make an açaí bowl at home with no blender: scoop 2/3 cup of açaí sorbet, add granola, banana, strawberry and coconut, and serve. The base is already made.

item.title: Cupuaçu: the Amazon fruit in our Cupuaçu & Coconut sorbet
item.description: Cupuaçu is an Amazon fruit with a brown shell and creamy white pulp, a relative of cacao. What it is, where it grows, and how it ends up in our sorbet.

item.title: Building an açaí bowl program for a campus or café: 69 bowls a bucket, no blender
item.description: A 10.2 kg bucket of açaí sorbet gives about 69 bowls at 2/3 cup, with no blender. The four-bowl menu, the Operator Kit, and the Vistar item numbers to order.
